What is BOTOX®?

BOTOX® is a purified form of botulinum toxin type A, a neurotoxin that temporarily relaxes muscles by blocking nerve signals. This relaxation prevents the muscles from contracting, thereby reducing the appearance of dynamic wrinkles caused by repetitive facial expressions. BOTOX® has been approved by the FDA for cosmetic use and is widely regarded for its safety and efficacy.

What is BOTOX® Used For?

BOTOX® is versatile and can be used to treat a variety of cosmetic and medical conditions, including:

Forehead Lines

Smooth out horizontal lines that form across the forehead.

Frown Lines

Reduce the appearance of vertical lines between the eyebrows, also known as “11 lines.”

Crow's Feet

Diminish the fine lines that appear at the corners of the eyes.

Brow Lift

Achieve a subtle lift of the eyebrows, enhancing the shape and position of the brows.

Bunny Lines

Minimize the lines that form on the sides of the nose when you smile.

Chin Dimples

Smooth out the dimpling or “orange peel” texture on the chin.

Jawline Slimming

Relax the masseter muscles to create a slimmer jawline.

Hyperhidrosis

Treat excessive sweating in areas like the underarms, palms, and soles of the feet.

Why Patients Choose BOTOX®

Widely Trusted

BOTOX® is the most popular non-surgical cosmetic treatment worldwide, with millions of procedures performed annually.

Quick Results

Most patients see noticeable improvements within 3-5 days after the treatment, with full results appearing in about two weeks.

Long-Lasting Effects

The effects of BOTOX® typically last 3-4 months, with regular treatments providing continuous benefits.

Minimal Downtime

BOTOX® injections involve minimal downtime, allowing you to resume your normal activities immediately.

Safety of BOTOX® Injections

At AestheticEye, patient safety is our top priority. BOTOX® has been extensively studied and proven to be safe when administered by a qualified and experienced practitioner. Common side effects are usually mild and temporary, including slight redness, swelling, or bruising at the injection sites. Serious side effects are rare but can occur, which is why it’s essential to receive treatment from a reputable clinic with skilled professionals.
